1. **`Fixes #36023` closes the card while two of its acceptance lines are NOT MEASURED for the one type this PR adds.** The 验收 lines are 「每种类型进入编辑：这一行的高度仍是 32 … 逐个类型量一遍，把结果列在 PR 里」 and 「深色主题下各看一遍」. In plugin-grid, `fieldInlineReadOnlyKind` gives the same answers for every other type: `NON_EDITABLE_FIELD_TYPES` is still checked first, and the carve-out applies only to the three rich types. Its only readers are `objectGridCellFacts.ts` and `objectGridPersistedColumns.ts`. None of `fieldInlineReadOnlyKind`, `isFieldInlineEditable`, `inlineEditorPlacement` or `PANEL_EDITOR_FIELD_TYPES` is on the plugin-grid entry (`src/index.tsx`), so moving them changes no published declaration. The rewritten test (markdown read-only becomes editable) is the expected inversion for this widening, and the PR body names it.

**The changeset was read sentence by sentence against `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` at this head.**
- "On a select-first grid … a panel under the cell": `editsBelow = isEditing && selectFirst && editorBelow` gives `placement="below"`. Otherwise the placement is `cover`.
- "on a select-first grid Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves": the injected editor's wrapper commits a `TEXTAREA` only under `selectFirst && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)`. Without `cellSelection`, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter in the text box commits nothing, and plain Enter is left to the textarea as a new line.
- "Esc discards": the same wrapper calls `exitEdit(true)` in both models, which reverts the edit session or discards the cell change.
- "a click outside keeps the text as a pending change for the grid's save buttons": the document `pointerdown` listener (armed while an injected editor is mounted) calls `saveEdit(true)` in both models. Without the select-first model, `autosaves` is false, so it stages rather than writes.
- "Backspace or Delete on the selected cell of a select-first grid": clearing a selected cell exists only in the select-first model.
